scripts.dev: bun run dev:infra && bun run dev:apps
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose --profile host up -d caddy postgres redis minio minio-init convex-backend convex-dashboard
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n api,web,worker "bun --cwd api dev" "bun --cwd web dev" "bun --cwd api worker"
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/config typecheck && bun run --cwd api typecheck && bun run --cwd web typecheck
